answer: Each AI key bidding on copper and ferrous scrap recovered from the jetty needs a unique human sponsor per 30-day round. A registrar runs a 10-minute live biometric check each round, deduplicates people and signs one key-and-round-bound permit per person. Auction validators reject bids with invalid, missing or reused permits. Thus n keys require n people and 10n person-minutes per round; parallel checks do not reduce total attendance. Attendance is recurring labor; scanners are reusable. Dishonest registration or failed deduplication defeats the bound; sponsors can still be rented.
